items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: You see my husband be going to the dance and I'd follow them.

ctx.x: Was he good? Was he good? Mm-hmm. But where did you hear him play?

I used to go to dances with him. At the economy hall, they had a hall by the name of Economy Hall at that time. Yes. And they had another hall at that time, by the name of Persevering Hall. Mm-hmm. And then they had another hall, let me see what the, that hall was named. Oh, I can't think of that. But anyway, anyway, it was three, three different dances I used to go with them. I used to follow them. When you say you'd go with them, like what, what, what do you mean exactly? I'd go to the dance with them. Yeah.…
